notes: All 20 clubs were read through the Penn Clubs directory endpoint, one fetch each. One extra fetch of each club's own website was made where the entry linked one (13 sites). Two site fetches followed a 301 redirect (Access Engineering and Aerospace Club), and the Alpha Omega Epsilon site returned an empty page twice, so it gave no evidence. Statuses: active 4 (AI@Penn, Allied Scholars, Alpha Kappa Alpha, Alzheimer's Buddies), probably_active 6 (ACM SIGGRAPH, AMHS, Aerial Robotics, Aerospace Club, Alpha Kappa Delta Phi, Alpha Kappa Psi), dormant 1 (Admissions Dean's Advisory Board), unknown 9 (215Records, Access Engineering, Active Minds, Adventist Students for Christ, Advocates for Neurodiversity, African Student Association, AI Society at Penn, Albanian Society, Alpha Omega Epsilon). Unknown records have no summary, categories or interests, so they are held back. Several directory labels read INACTIVE or UNDER REVIEW while the entry or club site has dated 2026 items; those are flagged in each record's notes. Individual students' names and personal emails were not recorded (Admissions board, Adventist, Aerospace sub team leads, Alpha Kappa Delta Phi rush chairs). Zoom, Facebook invite and listserv links were not copied. Searches used: 0. Fetches used: 46 of 60.
